pick.headline: Spanish Embassy burned in Guatemala City
pick.summary: On January 31, 1980, Guatemalan police stormed the Spanish Embassy, which had been occupied by peasant protesters; a fire killed 37 people, and Spain broke relations.
pick.significance: The massacre became a defining atrocity of Guatemala's civil war; the only peasant survivor was later abducted from hospital and killed.
pick.fbis: The Latin America tables of contents for February 1980 listed under Guatemala the minister approving an OAS resolution on the Spanish Embassy incident and claims that the peasants were massacred to benefit U.S. firms.
